title: AirPods Black Friday deals 2026 UK: which models will actually drop?
seoTitle: AirPods Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Prices to Wait For
description: AirPods Black Friday 2026: today's best UK prices for AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 5 and Max 2, plus the price worth waiting for on each.
intro:
**Short answer: the AirPods Pro 3 at £200 at Amazon are the AirPods to buy today, £19 under Apple's price.** Yesterday's £119 deal on the AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case has ended: Amazon is back to the full £139. The standard AirPods 5 are £119 everywhere, with no discount yet, and the AirPods Max 2 are £449 at Amazon, £50 off.

The Pro 3 hit about £175 to £183 earlier in the year, so if you can wait, Amazon's Black Friday Week (19 to 30 November) is the likeliest time for them to drop again. Black Friday itself is on 27 November. Prices were last checked on 17 November 2026.

body:
## AirPods prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are today's prices from big UK retailers, and the lows to beat. At or below the lows, it's a genuinely good deal.

- **AirPods Pro 3 (RRP £219):** £200 at Amazon today. They have been as low as about £175 this year, and about £183 at Amazon during Prime Big Deal Days in October. Anything under £190 is good; under £180 is excellent.
- **AirPods 5 (RRP £119):** £119 at Amazon and elsewhere. A first Black Friday cut is possible but not certain.
- **AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case (RRP £139):** back to £139 at Amazon on 17 November, after a short-lived £119 deal. £119 is the price to wait for.
- **AirPods 4 with ANC (RRP £169):** £109 at John Lewis and £129 at Amazon. Only worth it at £109, and even then the AirPods 5 are the better buy for £10 more.
- **AirPods Max 2 (RRP £499):** £449 at Amazon, AO and Boots. Under £450 is a good price; under £430 would be better still.

## Which AirPods should you buy?

**AirPods 5:** open-fit buds with no silicone tips, now with noise cancelling as standard. Comfortable if in-ear tips bother you, but because they don't seal, they still let in more noise than the Pro models. At £119 they're the best-value AirPods this year. The wireless-charging version is £139, so only pay extra if you want to drop them on a charging pad.

**AirPods Pro 3:** the ones most people should buy. They seal in your ear, so noise cancelling is much stronger, and they include heart-rate tracking for workouts. Worth the extra if you commute or travel.

**AirPods Max 2:** over-ear headphones with the best sound in the range, but heavy and expensive. £449 at Amazon, AO and Boots is £50 off list.

## Will AirPods be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Most likely, yes, for the Pro 3. Last year they were brand new and stayed at full price through Black Friday, while older models were cut. This year they're a year old, they've already dropped to about £175 to £183, and Amazon usually matches or beats its own Prime sale prices in November. The AirPods 5 are in the position the Pro 3 were in last year: new, and unlikely to see a big cut.

**Currys** started its Black Friday sale early, on 28 October. Its price guarantee means that if you buy before 24 November and the price drops again before 1 December, you can claim the difference, as long as you register by 1 December. We couldn't check Currys' AirPods prices today, so compare before you buy.

Apple itself doesn't cut prices. Last year it offered an Apple gift card with AirPods instead (£40 with the Pro 3), which is worth less than a straight discount at Amazon or Currys.

## Avoid these traps

- **Marketplace sellers.** You'll see AirPods Pro 3 and Max 2 cheaper on eBay and OnBuy from third-party sellers. Some are fine, but fakes are common. Stick to Apple, Amazon (sold by Amazon), Argos, Currys, John Lewis or Very.
- **Old "was" prices.** Some retailers quote a "was" price that only applied for a few weeks in the summer. Compare with the target prices above instead.
- **AirPods Pro 2.** They're no longer sold new by the big retailers, so a cheap "Pro 2" listing is likely old stock or a marketplace seller.

### Will AirPods Pro 3 be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Probably. They hit about £183 at Amazon in early October, and big Black Friday prices usually match or beat Prime sale prices. Aim for under £190.

### Are the AirPods 5 worth buying over the AirPods 4?

Usually, yes. The AirPods 5 have noise cancelling as standard for £119 and cancel more noise than the AirPods 4 with ANC. The 4 with ANC are £109 at John Lewis today, which is only worth it if every £10 counts or you want a wireless charging case without paying £139.

### Where is cheapest for AirPods in the UK?

Amazon usually has the lowest price on the Pro models during big sales. John Lewis and Very often match each other, and John Lewis currently has the cheapest AirPods 4 with ANC.

### Is Apple releasing new AirPods before Christmas?

Not as far as we know. The AirPods 5 arrived in September and the AirPods Max 2 in March. Rumours of a camera-equipped model point to next year.
